captions.text: {winner} and {loser} stand side by side under the floodlights as another season reaches its finish.
{winner} shakes hands with {loser} on the halfway line of a floodlit stadium.
Season over: {winner} and {loser} pose in matching suits beneath the stadium lights.
{loser} congratulates {winner} in the floodlit stadium as the final standings settle for another year.
{winner} and {loser} share a quiet word in the stands once the season's points are counted.
Under the lights, {winner} smiles beside {loser}, who is already talking about next season.
{winner} and {loser} walk out onto the floodlit pitch together for the end of season photograph.
The season's work done, {winner} and {loser} pause in the dugout of a floodlit stadium.
{managerA} and {managerB} stand shoulder to shoulder in the floodlit stadium after a season that ended level.
Nothing to split them: {managerA} and {managerB} share the centre circle under the stadium lights.
{managerA} shakes hands with {managerB} in the floodlit stadium, honours even after a level season.
{managerA}, left, and {managerB} pose back to back beneath the floodlights, still level on the season.
{managerA} and {managerB} share a shrug and a smile in the dugout after a drawn season.
Dead even: {managerA} and {managerB} stand at opposite ends of the tunnel, eyeing each other.
{managerA} and {managerB} sit side by side in the empty stands, the season scoreboard showing a draw.
Under the lights, {managerA} and {managerB} raise one hand each as the season finishes all square.
Confetti falls on {winner} and {loser} in the floodlit stadium on the final night of the Showdown.
{winner} lifts both arms as confetti swirls around {loser} on the Showdown's closing night.
{loser} applauds {winner} beneath a shower of confetti as the Showdown comes to an end.
Final night: {winner} and {loser} stand in a storm of confetti under the stadium lights.
{winner} and {loser} share a handshake as confetti settles on the pitch after the final season.
Paper streamers rain down on {winner}, with {loser} alongside, on the last night of the Showdown.
{winner} grins through the confetti while {loser} offers warm applause in the floodlit stadium.
The Showdown ends in colour as {winner} and {loser} pose amid falling confetti on the pitch.
{winner} and {loser} stand in the trophy hall on the night the Golden Showdown is decided.
{winner} admires the gleaming shelves of the trophy hall as {loser} looks on with a smile.
Golden night: {loser} congratulates {winner} among the silverware of the trophy hall.
{winner} and {loser} pose beside the polished cabinets in the trophy hall after the Golden Showdown.
Under warm lights in the trophy hall, {winner} shakes hands with {loser} on Golden Showdown night.
{loser} raises a glass to {winner} in the trophy hall as the Golden Showdown draws to a close.
{winner} and {loser} walk the length of the trophy hall on Golden Showdown night.
A long road ends in the trophy hall, where {winner} and {loser} mark the Golden Showdown.
{winner} raises a fist in the floodlit stadium after winning the season with {winnerClub}.
Fist in the air, {winner} celebrates a winning season in the {winnerClub} dugout.
{winner} punches the air under the stadium floodlights after a winning season with {winnerClub}.
{winner} celebrates with a raised fist in the trophy hall, the {winnerClub} season safely won.
A delighted {winner} salutes the stands after a winning season in charge of {winnerClub}.
{winner} clenches a fist and roars in the lounge as the {winnerClub} season ends on top.
Suited and smiling, {winner} raises a fist on the touchline for {winnerClub}.
{winner} holds a fist aloft in the {winnerClub} tunnel, savouring a winning season.
{loser} stands arms crossed in the {loserClub} dugout, already sketching plans for next season.
Hand on chin, {loser} studies the floodlit pitch with next season for {loserClub} in mind.
{loser} looks out over the stadium, quietly determined to bring silverware to {loserClub}.
{loser} sits in the lounge, chin in hand, mapping out the next {loserClub} campaign.
Arms folded, {loser} surveys the trophy hall and picks out a space for {loserClub}.
{loser} pauses on the touchline, deep in thought about the season ahead for {loserClub}.
A focused {loser} considers the next move for {loserClub} under the stadium lights.
{loser} leans on the {loserClub} dugout, hand on chin, plotting a stronger season.

quotes.text: A good season. Now I have to do it all over again.
The trophy cabinet needed dusting anyway, so this works out nicely.
I'll enjoy tonight. Tomorrow the next season starts and the slate is clean.
Proud of {winnerClub}. Proud of the late nights. Mostly proud of the late nights.
Winning a season never gets old. Ask me again next year.
The scoreboard was kind to me. I won't pretend otherwise.
Put the kettle on. This one deserves a proper celebration.
I respect my rival far too much to relax now.
Close enough to taste it. Next season, I take the whole plate.
Fair play to them. I'm already planning my reply.
{loserClub} will be back. Write that down somewhere safe.
Second this time. The console and I are having a long chat tonight.
Every season teaches you something. This one taught me plenty.
No excuses. Just a fresh season and a very motivated manager.
I've circled next season on the calendar. In red.
Losing a season stings, but the rivalry is the best part.
Level again. Nobody wins, and honestly, nobody sleeps tonight either.
A draw feels strange. Like a handshake that goes on too long.
We cancelled each other out. Next season, one of us blinks.
Honours even. I'll take it, but I won't enjoy it.
Dead level. The scoreboard clearly cannot pick a favourite.
Half the bragging rights each. That's not how bragging works.
A drawn season means the next one matters twice as much.
Nobody won, nobody lost, and everybody wants a rematch.
Every late night was worth it. Every single one.
This one goes straight to the top shelf of the cabinet.
Proud of {winnerClub}, proud of the journey, and very tired.
A Showdown win lasts forever. The bragging rights last even longer.
My rival made me better. I'll say that once, and only once.
Champion has a nice ring to it. I may change my doorbell.
We started this to have fun. Winning it is a lovely bonus.
I'll frame the final scoreboard and hang it above the console.
Hats off. They earned it. And I'm already asking for a rematch.
Not my Showdown, but what a ride with {loserClub}.
Second place, but first in line for the next Showdown.
I'll be back, and I'll bring a bigger trophy cabinet.
Losing to a friend is the best way to lose, apparently.
Great rival, great fun, tough result. Rematch soon, please.
I enjoyed every season, even the ones that went wrong.
Congratulations to them. Now, where's the button for a new Showdown?
Golden. I didn't think I'd ever say that out loud.
The long road ends here, and it ends in gold.
Every season was a brick. Tonight the house is finished.
Gold suits {winnerClub}. Gold suits everyone, really.
I'm going to need a much bigger shelf for this one.
So many seasons of nerves, and I'd happily do every one again.
A Golden Showdown. My rival pushed me every step of the way.
They'll talk about this one for years. Well, the Gazette will.

briefs.head: Europe's biggest prize
briefs.text: {manager} guides {club} to Champions League glory, and the trophy cabinet suddenly looks very grand indeed.

briefs.head: Continental crown secured
briefs.text: {club} are kings of Europe after {manager} masters the Champions League. Expect the celebrations to run well past bedtime.

briefs.head: A starry night
briefs.text: The Champions League trophy heads home with {manager} and {club}. Nothing on the scoreboard shines quite so brightly.

briefs.head: Top of Europe
briefs.text: {manager} takes {club} all the way in the Champions League, the biggest prize this desk can report.

briefs.head: The big one
briefs.text: Champions League winners. {manager} lets that sink in, then quietly asks for extra shelving for {club}.

briefs.head: European dream realised
briefs.text: {club} lift the Champions League under {manager}, a season the trophy desk will be talking about for a long time.

briefs.head: Cabinet's crown jewel
briefs.text: The Champions League trophy now sits at the heart of the {club} cabinet, placed there with care by {manager}.

briefs.head: Europe bows down
briefs.text: {manager} conquers the Champions League with {club}. The rival will need a very good season to answer this.

briefs.head: Europa glory
briefs.text: {manager} steers {club} to Europa League success, and a shiny new trophy joins the collection.

briefs.head: Silver from Europe
briefs.text: {club} bring the Europa League trophy home under {manager}, proof that continental nights can end brilliantly.

briefs.head: Europa joy
briefs.text: A Europa League win for {club}. {manager} calls it a lovely trip abroad with a very heavy souvenir.

briefs.head: Continental success
briefs.text: {manager} adds the Europa League to the {club} story, a trophy that looks splendid under the cabinet lights.

briefs.head: Europa conquered
briefs.text: {club} rule the Europa League this season, and {manager} has the silverware to prove it.

briefs.head: Travelling trophy
briefs.text: {manager} takes {club} on a European adventure that ends with the Europa League trophy in the luggage.

briefs.head: Euro silverware
briefs.text: The Europa League belongs to {club}. {manager} has already chosen the best spot for it in the cabinet.

briefs.head: Europa crown
briefs.text: {manager} and {club} finish the Europa League on top, and the trophy desk raises a cup of tea in salute.

briefs.head: Champions of the league
briefs.text: {manager} leads {club} to the league title, the reward for a whole season of steady, stubborn excellence.

briefs.head: Title secured
briefs.text: {club} are league champions. {manager} can finally stop refreshing the table and start enjoying the view.

briefs.head: Top of the pile
briefs.text: {manager} finishes the season with {club} on top of the league, and the title trophy is heading home.

briefs.head: League crown
briefs.text: The league title belongs to {club}. {manager} called it a marathon, and nobody at the desk disagrees.

briefs.head: The long haul
briefs.text: A league title is won over a full season, and {manager} has done exactly that with {club}.

briefs.head: Table toppers
briefs.text: {club} end the campaign as league champions under {manager}, and the trophy cabinet gladly makes room.

briefs.head: Title in the bag
briefs.text: {manager} brings the league title to {club}, a trophy that rewards patience, nerve and plenty of late nights.

briefs.head: Kings of the league
briefs.text: League champions {club} salute {manager}, whose season-long effort ends with the title safely in the cabinet.

briefs.head: Cup comes home
briefs.text: {manager} guides {club} to domestic cup glory, and the cabinet welcomes a bright new addition.

briefs.head: Cup winners
briefs.text: {club} lift the domestic cup. {manager} insists every trophy counts, and the scoreboard happily agrees.

briefs.head: Knockout success
briefs.text: {manager} survives every round with {club} and finishes proudly holding the domestic cup aloft.

briefs.head: Silver at home
briefs.text: The domestic cup belongs to {club} this season, a fine reward for {manager} and a lovely shine for the shelf.

briefs.head: Cup run complete
briefs.text: {manager} takes {club} all the way in the domestic cup, and the celebrations start the moment the season closes.

briefs.head: Cup of joy
briefs.text: Domestic cup winners {club} have {manager} to thank for a trophy that brightens any cabinet.

briefs.head: Another shelf filled
briefs.text: {manager} adds the domestic cup to the {club} collection. Small trophy, says the rival. Shiny trophy, says the desk.

briefs.head: Cup magic
briefs.text: {club} win the domestic cup under {manager}, proving that knockout nerves can be tamed with a steady hand.

briefs.head: Bonus earned
briefs.text: {manager} earns the performance bonus with {club}, a reward for a season that ticked the right boxes.

briefs.head: Performance pays
briefs.text: {club} hit the marks this season, and {manager} collects the performance bonus with a satisfied nod.

briefs.head: Extra credit
briefs.text: The performance bonus goes to {manager}, whose {club} side did more than enough to impress the trophy desk.

briefs.head: A tidy bonus
briefs.text: {manager} picks up the performance bonus for {club}. Small extras like this have a habit of deciding rivalries.

briefs.head: Strong showing
briefs.text: {club} put together a season worth rewarding, and {manager} proudly pockets the performance bonus.

briefs.head: Bonus banked
briefs.text: {manager} banks the performance bonus with {club}, and the overall table looks a little friendlier tonight.

briefs.head: Above and beyond
briefs.text: The performance bonus lands with {manager} and {club}, a quiet reward that could prove loud later on.

briefs.head: Job well done
briefs.text: {manager} delivers a season good enough for the performance bonus, and {club} have every reason to smile.

briefs.head: Awards night
briefs.text: {manager} collects the awards bonus for {club}, and the trophy desk polishes a spot on the mantelpiece.

briefs.head: Recognition arrives
briefs.text: {club} earn the awards bonus this season, a fine tribute to the work {manager} put in.

briefs.head: Honours roll in
briefs.text: The awards bonus goes to {manager} and {club}. Someone please fetch a bigger envelope.

briefs.head: Applause all round
briefs.text: {manager} and {club} take the awards bonus, a reward that looks just as good on the scoreboard as in the cabinet.

briefs.head: Award winners
briefs.text: {club} bring home the awards bonus under {manager}, who accepts it with only a modest amount of grinning.

briefs.head: Honoured season
briefs.text: {manager} secures the awards bonus for {club}, proof that the season impressed beyond the trophy count.

briefs.head: Bonus on stage
briefs.text: {manager} steps up for the awards bonus on behalf of {club}, and the desk offers a polite round of applause.

briefs.head: Prize-giving success
briefs.text: The awards bonus heads to {club}. {manager} says the speech is ready and will mercifully be brief.

briefs.head: Quiet season
briefs.text: No silverware for {manager} and {club} this time, but quiet seasons often come right before loud ones.

briefs.head: Room to grow
briefs.text: The {club} cabinet stays empty for now, which simply leaves plenty of space for {manager} to fill next season.

briefs.head: Dusting the shelves
briefs.text: {manager} spends the break dusting empty shelves at {club}, ready for the trophies still to come.

briefs.head: Next time
briefs.text: Nothing for {club} this season, but {manager} is already back at the console with fresh plans.

briefs.head: Rebuilding hope
briefs.text: An empty cabinet for {manager} and {club}. Every great story needs a chapter where the hero regroups.

briefs.head: Fresh start beckons
briefs.text: {club} finish without a trophy, but {manager} knows a new season wipes the slate clean for everyone.

briefs.head: Patience pays
briefs.text: No trophies for {manager} this time. The {club} cabinet waits patiently, and the desk suspects it won't wait long.

briefs.head: Lessons learned
briefs.text: {manager} and {club} come away empty handed, but full of ideas. Watch this space next season.
